words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) opens the ayah by negating the whole copular state, not only the act of rejection. Its force stretches through {{ar:يَكُنِ}} ({{tr:yakuni}}) toward {{ar:مُنفَكِّينَ}} ({{tr:munfakkīna}}), keeping a past-state denial suspended until {{ar:حَتَّىٰ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) introduces the proof’s arrival as the sole endpoint. The final nasal of the negator closes directly into the governed verb, making its jussive control audible.

words.prose: {{ar:يَكُنِ}} ({{tr:yakuni}}) is the copular hinge of the first clause: it does not deny that the groups existed, create a new state, or report simple past being, but denies that they occupied the release-state named by {{ar:مُنفَكِّينَ}} ({{tr:munfakkīna}}). Its singular shape is normal before the plural relative subject, and its jussive/apocopated form under {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) is carried by liaison into the subject without becoming indicative. The delayed predicate makes the missing state arrive as the first beat’s payoff, while the familiar negated-being pattern is specialized here into social-state denial rather than the theological formula seen at 112:4.

words.prose: {{ar:مُنفَكِّينَ}} ({{tr:munfakkīna}}) is the delayed predicate where the first beat lands: the groups were not in a state of being unfastened or released. The rare {{ar:ف ك ك}} ({{tr:f-k-k}}) root makes the absence of release feel like bondage, especially beside the other Quranic liberation use at 90:13, where physical freeing contrasts with this communal and epistemic non-release. Form VII adds middle/reflexive pressure, so the denied state is their becoming released rather than simply being separated by an outside force, and the exact participial mechanism is concentrated here. The word meets {{ar:ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}), where unfastening and clarifying/separating converge; its doubled stop cluster makes the pressure of rupture audible.

words.prose: {{ar:تَأْتِيَهُمُ}} ({{tr:taʾtiyahumu}}) executes the endpoint: the proof comes to them. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}) is the final subject that completes the endpoint clause: the proof is what comes. Its definite singular form makes the ayah land on one recognizable proof, and 98:2-3 immediately specify that proof through the messenger and scripture scene. The root keeps clarity, distinction, legal-evidentiary force, and separation together, so the proof answers both the covering/rejection of {{ar:كَفَرُوا}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) and the non-release of {{ar:مُنفَكِّينَ}} ({{tr:munfakkīna}}). topics.headline: manifest proof clarifies and separates

topics.reason: The root range supports clarity, distinction, separation, and evidence.

topics.headline: definite singular identifiable proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof is presented as identifiable, not as just any sign.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular on first mention, and 98:2-3 immediately specifies the proof scene.

topics.headline: final proof answers the opening negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close by naming the condition that answers the denied state.
topics.reason: The frame runs from {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) to {{ar:ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}).

topics.headline: proof becomes the surah’s lexical axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing word as the concept the surah keeps elaborating (98:4).
topics.reason: Rows with 98:4 and title evidence support the word as a local axis.

topics.headline: acoustic landing at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the proof noun as a weighted landing for the endpoint clause.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce the structural close.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated state in yakun munfakkina is bounded by hatta and the arrival of al-bayyina.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse places covering, joined textual affiliation, and associated allegiance around F-K-K's image of opening a locked or interlaced thing. Read through that material pattern, the named configuration does not unfasten by itself; the arriving bayyina makes the covered matter manifest and supplies the release event.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication supplies the continuing pre-arrival state in which the configuration holds.
Covering and concealment supply the closed layer that the later disclosure must expose.
Joining one thing to another gives the Book-affiliation a materially assembled aspect within the held configuration.
Sharing and partnership supply mixed allegiance as another form of attachment.
Opening what is locked and separating what is interlaced provide the central release operation.
Coming and arriving make the release depend on an event entering the existing state.
Appearance and becoming clear supply the disclosure that opens the covered configuration.

changed_reading.before: The groups would not stop disbelieving until enough proof reached them.
changed_reading.after: The groups occupy a covered, interlocked configuration that does not open on its own; the arriving disclosure is an operative release event, not merely extra information.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Munfakkina and bayyina each carry separation imagery, while hatta makes the bayyina's arrival a boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ahl and kitab encode belonging and enrollment, while shirk encodes participation. F-K-K can mean departure from a state, and B-Y-N can mean both clarity and separation after connection. The until-clause can therefore mark the point at which previously held affiliations become distinguishable and part, without asserting that every member accepts the evidence.

activation_trace.role: A community bound by closeness and belonging supplies the initial affiliation being tested.
Enrollment in a register or group sharpens Book-affiliation as a counted social category.
Participation in a shared relation supplies a second mode of group attachment.
Separation from a thing, together with the negated continuation idiom, makes non-departure the pre-threshold state.
Parting after connection supplies bayyina with a sorting effect alongside its evidentiary sense.
Becoming visible supplies the clarity by which the attached parties can be distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is expected to end a common error by producing agreement.
changed_reading.after: The evidence is a threshold that ends undifferentiated attachment and begins sorting; clarification may produce parting rather than consensus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Kitab, munfakkina, and bayyina converge on binding instrument, release, and evidentiary disclosure within the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: K-T-B can name a binding decree and, more distantly, a written manumission contract; F-K-K can release a pledge, captive, or neck. Their co-presence permits a juridical analogy in which the named parties remain under a registered or binding condition until a qualifying disclosure arrives and triggers adjudicable release.

activation_trace.role: A binding decree or judgment supplies the condition whose force requires formal resolution.
The written manumission contract supplies the exploratory documentary bridge between kitab and release.
Freeing a pledge, captive, or neck supplies the juridical release operation.
Arrival supplies the procedural threshold at which release can occur.
Disclosure by speech, writing, or sign supplies the evidentiary instrument that makes the condition resolvable.

changed_reading.before: Munfakkina simply means ceasing or leaving once proof appears.
changed_reading.after: The clause can be heard as a release formula: a binding condition persists until an evidentiary instrument arrives and makes formal unfastening possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bayyina is no longer only a clear proposition. Dispatch, a messenger, sequential recitation, written sheets, and removal of contamination make it an embodied and performed disclosure whose delivery can do the opening posited by the focus.

activation_trace.role: Opening a locked or interlaced thing anchors the effect that the performed disclosure is inferred to have.
Disclosing meaning by expression or sign anchors bayyina in communicative performance.
Messenger and message give the evidence a personal carrier and a transmitted commission.
Following in sequence makes disclosure an ordered recitative process rather than a static object.
Written sheets provide the material surface from which the disclosure is performed.
Purity as removal of stain qualifies the transmitting medium as cleared of contaminating admixture.

structural_cues: 98:2 immediately follows al-bayyina with an indefinite messenger from God who recites purified sheets, functioning as its concrete specification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence bayyina, messenger, recitation, sheets, and purification; I infer that this delivered performance is what acts on the locked focus configuration. A live alternative is that 98:2 only identifies the proof while its recitation has no special causal role.

changed_reading.before: A clear proposition arrives and supplies enough information to permit cessation.
changed_reading.after: The arriving bayyina is a dispatched person performing ordered recitation from purified written surfaces; disclosure acts through embodied delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The purified sheets contain plural writings, and Q-W-M describes those contents through uprightness and sustaining structure. This strengthens the documentary baseline: the disclosure carries norms that stand, support, and supply a measure against which the prior entanglement can be opened.

activation_trace.role: Binding decree or judgment anchors the possibility that kitab carries normatively effective contents.
Opening the interlaced state supplies the operation for which the upright writings become the inferred norm.
Plural binding writings supply operative prescriptions inside the purified sheets.
Uprightness and rectitude make the writings a standard that corrects a misaligned configuration.
Support and sustaining structure make those writings capable of holding a reordered life, not merely winning an argument.

structural_cues: The locative fiha makes the plural kutub contents of the purified sheets, and qayyima directly qualifies those contents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural writings characterized by Q-W-M; I infer that their upright and sustaining quality provides the norm that enables release from the focus configuration. A live alternative is that qayyima means simply sound or valuable, without a structural role in unfastening.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is a message whose clarity alone changes the situation.
changed_reading.after: The evidence is a purified carrier containing plural, normatively binding writings whose upright and sustaining content makes reordering possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence explicitly places division after the bayyina's arrival among recipients of the Book. T-F-R-Q actualizes the latent separation shared by F-K-K and B-Y-N, so the focus threshold is more plausibly a disclosure that ends undifferentiated attachment and precipitates accountable partition than a proof that mechanically produces consensus.

activation_trace.role: Departure from a state, or non-cessation under negation, anchors the focus as a pre-arrival non-separation.
Parting after connection gives the focus bayyina a latent partitioning capacity.
Becoming clear supplies the disclosure by which the ensuing partition becomes accountable.
Scattering into parts supplies the overt post-arrival realization of the focus's latent unfastening.
The written Book identifies the divided recipients with the textual affiliation already named in the focus.
After in contrast to before fixes division on the far side of the evidence event.
Coming and obtaining repeat the arrival threshold with the bayyina as subject.
Separation and parting make the repeated bayyina resonate directly with the reported division.

structural_cues: 98:4 repeats al-bayyina and the Book recipients from the focus.
The restrictive sequence places tafarraqa only after the bayyina had come to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated constituency, explicit after-sequence, arrival, and division; I align that direction with the focus's hatta threshold and infer that disclosure precipitates sorting. A live alternative is that 98:4 reports later sectarianism without glossing munfakkina in 98:1.

changed_reading.before: The proof arrives and ends dissent by making everyone agree.
changed_reading.after: The proof arrives and ends an undifferentiated condition by exposing differences; its immediate narrative effect can be division rather than consensus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command sequence supplies a practical path through the focus entanglement: submit, extract allegiance from admixture, incline toward one direction, establish an upright practice, and externalize it through giving and growth. Release is therefore not an automatic cognitive reflex to evidence but an enacted reconfiguration away from shared allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Shared partnership anchors the mixed allegiance from which the later exclusive orientation separates.
Opening and separating an interlaced thing anchor realignment as practical unfastening.
Obligating request makes the post-disclosure path commanded rather than automatic.
Worship as submissive obedience supplies the governing posture of the realigned configuration.
Exclusive separation from partnership directly supplies extraction of allegiance from admixture.
Obedience and willing submission make the purified orientation a lived regime.
Inclining toward a direction supplies deliberate turning away from the prior mixed relation.
Uprightness and rectitude supply the stable geometry of the newly established practice.
Giving turns the response outward as a transfer rather than leaving it at inward assent.
Growth and increase make the outward transfer productive within the reordered life.

structural_cues: The restrictive ma umiru illa construction narrows the required response, then coordinates devotion, prayer, and giving.
Mukhlisina and hunafa qualify orientation while yuqimu and yutu make that orientation enacted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive command, purified devotion, directional inclination, established prayer, and giving; I infer that these actions describe how the focus unfastening is realized. A live alternative is that 98:5 states independent duties after the evidence narrative rather than the mechanism of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Once the evidence arrives, recognition itself releases the named groups from their prior state.
changed_reading.after: The evidence discloses a commanded route of disentanglement: exclusive submission, deliberate turning, upright practice, and productive giving must enact the release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus constituency returns after the evidence sequence and is still marked by K-F-R, then placed in fire with K-H-L-D's permanence and clinging. This weakens any model in which hatta guarantees universal release: the arrival ends the undifferentiated pre-evidence condition by exposing and sorting, but it does not coerce every attachment open.

activation_trace.role: The branch's combination of separation and negated non-cessation anchors the ambiguity between release and continued state.
The hunter's snare supplies a contained image of an attachment that evidence can expose without mechanically undoing.
Continued covering or rejection of truth marks the repeated constituency by response after disclosure.
Kindled fire supplies the consequence-location of the attachment that remains unopened.
Stable duration resistant to passing away turns continued attachment into an enduring outcome.
Clinging and remaining attached mirror the focus's non-unfastening at the level of consequence.
Evil and harm supply the evaluative classification made possible after evidence has sorted responses.

structural_cues: 98:6 repeats all three identifying elements from 98:1: those who disbelieved, the People of the Book, and the associators.
The repeated group is now located and evaluated after the intervening evidence and command sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated designation, continued K-F-R, fire, and permanence; I infer continuity between pre-arrival non-detachment and a post-arrival attachment that remains for one response class. A live alternative is that khulud describes punishment only and should not be read as a semantic continuation of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Until the evidence comes implies that everyone named will then detach from disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The terminus marks exposure and sorting, not forced conversion; a disbelieving subset remains attached and that attachment becomes durably lodged in consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins from inherited or communal labels, but the paired outcome verses classify by trusted response and deliberate repaired action, then rank within all created beings. Bayyina therefore not only reveals content; it cuts across prior affiliations and makes a new response-based belonging visible.

activation_trace.role: Communal closeness and belonging anchor the inherited affiliation from which the focus begins.
Enrollment in a register or group supplies the old counted category that the response classification crosses.
Separation after connection anchors the evidence as a recutting of prior group boundaries.
Heart-settling trust supplies the inward response criterion of the new class.
Intentional action supplies the outward criterion that prevents classification by assent alone.
Soundness opposed to corruption makes the actions reparative rather than merely active.
Excellence and selection supply the positive rank generated by the response-based classification.
Creation and bringing forth widen the comparison beyond inherited religious constituencies to created beings.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 use parallel those-who clauses and the shared al-bariyya classification while contrasting disbelief with trust plus action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel outcome classes and shared creation-wide ranking; I infer that evidence recuts the focus's inherited affiliations according to response. A live alternative is that the believing class is adjacent to, rather than drawn from or across, the groups named in 98:1.

changed_reading.before: The focus addresses fixed religious communities and asks whether those communities leave their position.
changed_reading.after: The communal labels are starting attachments; after disclosure, trust and reparative action make a new class that cuts across inherited belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: F-K-K's release is given a positive destination rather than left as endless detachment. Recompense, nearness, cultivation, sheltered garden, continuous provision, widened flow, permanence, and mutual satisfaction form a stable reciprocal habitat. The old bond opens so that a responding person can be reattached within a life-giving order.

activation_trace.role: Release from pledge or bondage anchors the departure whose positive destination the final context supplies.
A tie connecting parties permits disclosure to end one attachment while making another relation visible.
Action met by fitting recompense supplies the reciprocal transition from response to destination.
Nearness and presence locate the released person within relation rather than in mere absence from the old state.
Cultivation, repair, and completion make the destination a maintained order.
A garden sheltered by trees supplies a protective habitat for the new attachment.
Continuing provision and giving make the habitat actively sustaining.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies an ecological counterpart to unfastening.
Stable persistence supplies permanence to the newly entered order.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocity between the released people and God.

structural_cues: 98:8 moves from recompense and nearness through a flowing habitat to permanence and reciprocal satisfaction.
The closing sequence describes both durable place and durable relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reward, nearness, cultivated shelter, flow, permanence, and mutual satisfaction; I infer that this is the positive destination of the focus's release. A live alternative is that 98:8 is an independent reward description and does not specify the semantics of munfakkina.

changed_reading.before: Release means only stopping or leaving the former state.
changed_reading.after: Release opens an old bond so that responders can enter a cultivated, continuously supplied, permanent, and reciprocal relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from T-L-W to T-L-L rather than the morphology of yatlu itself. It remains valid as a packet-supplied branch echo anchored in the focus's F-K-K and communicative B-Y-N. Downstream prose must label it a kinetic analogy, not a lexical translation of recitation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs an arriving disclosure with opening what is locked or interlaced.

activation_trace.role: Opening the locked and separating the interlaced provide the focus operation receiving the kinetic echo.
Disclosure by expression anchors the kinetic image specifically to communicated evidence.
The non-dominant split branch's pouring and pushing supplies recitation with exploratory pressure against the locked configuration.

changed_reading.before: Recitation transports the content of an already complete proof.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained split-branch analogy, recitation can be imagined as a poured or pushing force that performs the opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates hydrological senses of A-T-Y and reads later streams back into the focus. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit coming and unfastening, with packet-backed flow imagery in 98:8. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for transmission, not as the lexical meaning of tatiha.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bayyina comes to a configuration described by F-K-K's opening of what is locked.

activation_trace.role: Opening a blockage or interlacing supplies the channel-clearing operation.
A watercourse and clearing its way turn arrival into exploratory directed flow.
A torrent arriving from elsewhere supplies the force of an external influx into a closed locality.
Unhindered running and spreading provide a later packet echo of successful circulation.
Widening a passage until it flows supplies the completed material analogue of unfastening.

changed_reading.before: Evidence arrives as a discrete object delivered to passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disclosure behaves like an incoming current that clears a blocked channel and replaces closure with sustained circulation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links K-F-R's covering with J-N-N's tree-covered garden, two morally opposite domains. It remains valid as a contrastive mechanism anchored in the focus's covering and clarification, with purification and garden shelter supplied by context. Downstream prose must call it a reversal of material imagery, not an equation of unbelief and garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from K-F-R's covering toward B-Y-N's becoming manifest.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the initial opaque enclosure.
Becoming visible supplies the discriminating transition rather than a simple rejection of every kind of cover.
Removal of stain supplies the distinction between contaminated concealment and a cleansed medium.
A garden concealed by trees supplies a later life-bearing and protective form of covering.

changed_reading.before: The movement is simply from covering to total exposure.
changed_reading.after: The disclosure differentiates destructive concealment from purified, life-bearing shelter: the problem is not cover as such but what the cover does.

strongest_changes: 98:2 turns an abstract proof into a sent, recited, purified performance.
98:4 strongly activates the focus's latent separation sense and blocks the assumption that arrival produces consensus.
98:5-98:7 shift release from automatic cognition to enacted exclusive response and response-based reclassification.
98:8 gives unfastening a positive destination in enduring flow, cultivation, nearness, and reciprocity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus unusually couples F-K-K's unlocking and release with B-Y-N's double capacity for clarity and separation. K-T-B adds binding and manumission imagery, while later division, practice, classification, and stable flow preserve several distinct readings instead of resolving them into one.
remaining_uncertainties: Munfakkina can foreground ceasing, departing, being released, or separating, and the omitted object leaves the exact attachment underdetermined.
The immediate relation of 98:2 to al-bayyina strongly suggests specification, but the degree to which recitation itself causes unfastening remains inferred.
The juridical, hydrological, covering-reversal, and non-dominant T-L-L activations are packet-grounded analogies rather than secure lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Unbelief as an entangling cover awaiting an unfastener.** Evidence: ك ف ر B001 covering/concealment and B003 covering or rejecting truth; ش ر ك B001 sharing/partnership and B006 hunter’s snare; ف ك ك B001 unfastening, B002 freeing from bondage/snare, B003 non-cessation in negated formulas; ب ي ن B004 clear proof and B001 separation. Structural cue: 98:4 repeats البينة and then reports تفرّق, while 98:6 repeats the same social pair in fire. Assigned role: الكفر covers, الشرك tangles, البينة separates/clarifies, منفكين marks the release that is denied until arrival. Abductive move: I infer that clarification functions like an unlocking force. Reading change: the ayah is less “they would not desist” abstractly and more “they remained fastened into a covered/social snare until a separator arrived.”

2. **A document-community bound by record before being judged.** Evidence: ء ه ل B001 people of belonging; ك ت ب B002 written book, B003 binding decree, B004 register/group enrollment; ك و ن B001 temporal predication. Structural cue: 98:2-3 brings purified sheets containing upright books, 98:5 calls the demand دين القيّمة, and 98:6 names the same أهل الكتاب in judgment. Assigned role: “people of the book” are not just holders of text but a group constituted by written obligation. Abductive move: I supply the legal arrow that being enrolled under a book makes the later proof accountable evidence. Reading change: the ayah becomes a status statement about communities already bound by records before the proof arrives.

3. **Arrival as a channel crossing into a closed field.** Evidence: ء ت ي B001 arrival, B004 watercourse/clearing flow, B005 torrent from elsewhere; ب ي ن B006 distance/gap and B004 appearance. Structural cue: 98:8’s rivers and flowing imagery retro-activate ء ت ي’s watercourse branch; 98:4’s جاءت البينة repeats arrival. Assigned role: the proof comes from outside the locked social condition like water entering a prepared channel. Abductive move: I infer that an arriving sign can alter the medium it enters, not merely inform observers. Reading change: البينة becomes an incoming event that reconfigures separations and channels, not merely a proposition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:8’s rivers made the ء ت ي watercourse/torrent branches unexpectedly useful for “تأتيهم البينة.” 98:6 also sharpened منفكين: the same pair who are not released in 98:1 appear as خالدين in 98:6, so non-release can harden into permanence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The proof as a release point that breaks a held configuration.** **Lexical evidence:** `مُنفَكِّين` anchors `ف ك ك` B003, “separating from something or, under negation, not ceasing,” and B001, “opening what is locked and separating what is interlaced.” **Structural cue and role:** the negated state lasts `حَتَّىٰ` the proof arrives, but 98:4 reverses stillness into `تَفَرَّقَ` only after that proof has come. The branch makes the proof a threshold at which a previously held configuration is unfastened. **Abductive move:** I infer that arrival triggers the release; grammar supplies the boundary and 98:4 supplies the later scattering, but causation is my directional arrow. **Reading change:** `مُنفَكِّين` becomes pressure-loaded rather than merely durative: the group is held until disclosure forces differentiated movement.

2. **Clarity that also sorts.** **Lexical evidence:** `ٱلْبَيِّنَة` anchors `ب ي ن` B004, “appearance and becoming clear,” and dormantly B001, “separation and parting.” **Structural cue and role:** the same noun closes 98:1 and 98:4, where its arrival is followed by division; nearby 98:3 calls the writings upright. Visibility and separation therefore operate together: the proof supplies a criterion by which responses become distinguishable. **Abductive move:** I infer that what reveals differences can produce a sorting event; the packet gives recurrence and sequence, not this general causal principle. **Reading change:** the proof is no longer static evidence offered to an undifferentiated audience; it is an event that makes latent differences publicly separable.

3. **Textual belonging without enacted fitness.** **Lexical evidence:** `أَهْل` anchors `ء ه ل` B001, “people bound by closeness and belonging,” while B003 supplies “being fit or worthy”; `ٱلْكِتَٰب` anchors `ك ت ب` B001, “joining one thing to another.” **Structural cue and role:** `أَهْل ٱلْكِتَٰب` recurs in 98:4 and 98:6, yet the joined textual object does not stop social scattering or the adverse classification in 98:6. B001 names corporate attachment; B003 functions as a corrected expectation rather than an asserted status. **Abductive move:** I infer that fitness for a received order must be enacted and is not guaranteed by affiliation. **Reading change:** “people of the book” reads as a potentially unstable bond to a joining artifact, not as an automatic commendation.

4. **Concealment sharpened into counter-disclosure.** **Lexical evidence:** `كَفَرُوا` anchors `ك ف ر` B001, “covering and concealment,” and B003, “covering or rejecting truth.” **Structural cue and role:** the packet follows the label with a messenger, purified sheets, clear proof, and then repeats the group beside `نَار` in 98:6, whose root `ن و ر` carries illumination as well as fire. The covering branch therefore works against an increasingly visible object. **Abductive move:** I infer deliberate overlay from persistence after disclosure; the packet establishes clarity-before-outcome but does not state the actors’ interior intent. **Reading change:** the fixed verb is sharpened from a generic class label into active resistance to disclosure, later answered by an exposing fire.

5. **Shared allegiance versus exclusive orientation.** **Lexical evidence:** `ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ` anchors `ش ر ك` B001, “sharing and partnership,” and B002, “associating a partner with God.” **Structural cue and role:** 98:5 answers this with `مُخْلِصِينَ`, `خ ل ص` B004, “exclusive separation from sharing,” and `حُنَفَاء`, a directional inclination. The fixed term thus names an allocation structure in which devotion is divided among claimants. **Abductive move:** I infer that the later command is a direct repair of the earlier divided allocation; their lexical opposition supplies the basis, while the repair relation is inferred. **Reading change:** `مُشْرِكِينَ` becomes a functional diagnosis of split allegiance, not merely the name of a population.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:4 unexpectedly reversed the apparent immobility of `مُنفَكِّين`: the proof does not simply end a duration but releases a visible scattering, activating `ف ك ك` B001 beside B003. 98:5 retrospectively decoded fixed `ش ر ك` through the opposite exclusivity of `خ ل ص` B004, and 98:6 sharpened fixed `ك ف ر` B001 and B003 by placing concealment beside fire’s illuminating `ن و ر` branch. Together these later ayat corrected any reading in which clarity mechanically produces consensus.

baseline.text: Kitap ehlinden inkâr edenler ve Allah'a ortak koşanlar, kendilerine açık kanıt gelinceye kadar ayrılacak değillerdi.

findings.text: Açık kanıt, tutulmuş bir durumun kilidini açan ve gizli ayrımları görünür toplumsal ayrışmaya dönüştüren bir eşik işlevi görür.
Kitaba mensubiyet, kendiliğinden yeterlilik sağlamaz; alınan birleştirici düzene uygunluk, kanıta verilen karşılıkla kazanılır.
İnkâr, giderek daha açık hâle gelen bir bildirimi örtme girişimi olarak keskinleşir ve sonraki ateşte zorunlu açığa çıkışla karşılanır.
Ortak koşma, bağlılığın birden çok pay sahibi arasında bölünmesi olarak görünür; sonraki yalnız Allah'a özgü yöneliş bu bölünmeyi giderir.
Kitap ehli ifadesi, yalnızca metin sahibi bir topluluğu değil, yazılı ve bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük altında bulunan topluluğu da belirtir.
Kanıtın gelişi, dışarıdan akan bir suyun kapalı bir alana girip mevcut ayrımları yeniden biçimlendirmesi gibi okunabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **98:1.** لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ — Birincil okuma: Kitap ehli içinden inkâr edenler ve müşrikler, açık delil gelinceye kadar çözülmüş değillerdi. Diğer ayetler bu durumu örtme, ortak koşma ve bağa takılma hâli olarak derinleştirir; beyyine ise sadece bilgi değil, kilidi açan, ayıran ve hesabı görünür kılan gelen olay olur. {ك ف ر B001; ك ف ر B003; ش ر ك B001; ش ر ك B006; ف ك ك B001; ف ك ك B002; ف ك ك B003; ء ت ي B001; ء ت ي B004; ب ي ن B004}
butuncul_okuma_line.arabic_text: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Arriving Proof
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A messenger-borne disclosure comes into a waiting community and makes what was hidden manifest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: coming into presence `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; arrival `ج ي ء:B001/m01`; manifest proof `ب ي ن:B004/m01`; message bearer `ر س ل:B002/m01`; bringing forward `ج ي ء:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The two coming-roots supply approach and achieved arrival, while the messenger carries the disclosed content and البينة names its unveiled state. Bringing is therefore both motion toward recipients and transfer into public intelligibility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Signs, Waymarks, and Beacons
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or hearer is oriented by signs that reveal meaning, mark a route, or shine from a distance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: explanatory sign `ب ي ن:B005/m01`; identifying sign `ء م ر:B005/m01`; road waymark `ء م ر:B005/m02`; beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: بيان makes meaning legible, أمارة fixes a recognizable marker, and the beacon extends recognition across distance. The surface proof thus resonates with practical navigation: disclosure is something by which a course can be found.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Distorted Reading and False Attribution
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written or spoken transmission is misread, converted into a false statement, and attached to someone as an accusation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: textual misreading `ص ح ف:B005/m01`; false following statement `ت ل و:B009/m01`; unattributed report `ر س ل:B011/m03`; accusation of unbelief `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; deficient judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel reverses orderly transmission. A page is read wrongly, the resulting utterance becomes false, and attribution hardens into accusation; lax judgment explains how the communicative chain loses integrity.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Marks are joined into durable textual objects that can state, value, and bind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field moves from physical stitching to appraisal and enforceable decree.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: From Broad Sheet to Bound Codex
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A broad writable surface receives script, is joined at its edges, and becomes a collected book.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad surface `ص ح ف:B001/m01`; written page `ص ح ف:B002/m01`; gathered codex `ص ح ف:B003/m01`; stitching and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; inscription `ك ت ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The document is reconstructed materially: breadth provides the sheet, writing fills it, joining closes it, and collected sheets produce the codex. The surface books therefore retain a latent craft image of assembled textual bodies.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Marks are joined into durable textual objects that can state, value, and bind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field moves from physical stitching to appraisal and enforceable decree.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Decree, Upright Record, and Appraisal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written statement acquires normative force and is assessed as straight, valuable, or authoritative.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prescribed decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; standing value `ق و م:B010/m01`; straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`; written explanation `ب ي ن:B005/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Writing moves beyond storage into prescription. The record stands because it is both normatively straight and open to appraisal, while بيان supplies the act by which its intended meaning is set out.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person is directed, straightened, and cleansed for undivided service.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual posture extends into lowered submission, purification media, and places built for worship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Undivided Worship
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Worship is directed to one deity through obedience and an allotment withheld from partners.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deity and worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; worshipful service `ع ب د:B003/m01`; commanded obedience `ء م ر:B002/m01`; obedient religion `د ي ن:B001/m01`; unshared devotion `خ ل ص:B004/m01`; obedient disposition `ر ض و:B006/m01`; obedient disposition `ر ض ي:B004/m01`; partner-making `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; lowered submission `ك ف ر:B014/m01`; willing submission `ك و ن:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The central act is exclusive direction: service and دين are assigned without a partner. The latent image of bodily lowering intensifies this orientation, while partnership marks the precise relation being refused.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person is directed, straightened, and cleansed for undivided service.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual posture extends into lowered submission, purification media, and places built for worship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Purified Character and Righteous Work
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Defilement is removed from the self, growth is made clean, and intentional work repairs what is wrong.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: moral purification `ط ه ر:B005/m01`; purity and increase `ز ك و:B002/m01`; filtering refinement `خ ل ص:B001/m01`; repair and righteousness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; moral good `خ ي ر:B001/m01`; expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cleansing, growth, repair, and work form one ethical process: contamination is removed, capacity develops, and the resulting action restores fitness. Expiation supplies the remedial counterpart when action has incurred a stain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Conviction and Learned Discernment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A claim is inwardly assented to and interpreted through knowledgeable, delegated judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: belief and assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; knowledge carried by fear-language `خ ش ي:B002/m01`; learned religious guide `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; delegated adjudication `د ي ن:B007/m01`; denial `ك ف ر:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belief is presented as a settled cognitive act rather than mere safety. Learned interpretation and delegated judgment give it a disciplined frame, while denial provides the opposing refusal to assent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Selection, Fitness, and Moral Polarity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Persons or actions are compared, chosen, and found fit against an opposing field of evil and ingratitude.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: excellence and selection `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; fitness `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; worthiness `ء ه ل:B003/m01`; compatibility `ز ك و:B004/m01`; evil `ش ر ر:B001/m01`; ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Evaluation proceeds from comparison to selection and then to demonstrated fitness. Evil and ingratitude are not merely labels but the negative pole against which worthiness, compatibility, and excellence become visible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What does not yet exist is formed, sustained, and capable of being raised again.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and resurrection share an image of standing into renewed existence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Formation into Existence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A created being comes into occurrence and is nurtured toward a repaired, viable state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: creation and formation `ب ر ء:B001/m01`; occurrence and existence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; nurture and repair `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; activation `ع م ل:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Origination is not an isolated instant. Coming-to-be is followed by nurture, repair, and activation, producing a causal sequence from formation to functioning life.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Judgment and Recompense
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conduct is judged under a written norm and answered with a corresponding outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: judgment and accounting `د ي ن:B002/m01`; recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; written decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; adjudicative standing `ق و م:B013/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The norm is fixed, the subject stands before it, and judgment produces a matched return. This gives the surface reward an institutional grammar of decree, hearing, and result.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tax and Tribute
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An authority levies a due, receives tribute, and marks the payer's subordinate position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assessed levy `ء ت ي:B008/m01`; tribute payment `ج ز ي:B004/m01`; lowered submission `ك ف ر:B014/m02`; debt obligation `د ي ن:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Giving becomes compulsory transfer: a due is assessed, collected as tribute, and embedded in a hierarchy. This is the fiscal counterpart of voluntary giving elsewhere in the surah's lexical field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Proxy, Sufficiency, and Guarantee
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One agent stands in for another, performs the required role, or guarantees that the obligation will be met.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: substitution `ج ز ي:B002/m01`; sufficiency in another's place `ج ز ي:B002/m02`; substitute office `ق و م:B007/m01`; surety `ك و ن:B003/m01`; delegated agent `ج ر ي:B003/m01`; guarantor `ر ض و:B006/m03`; guarantor `ر ض ي:B004/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Substitution is treated as a functional relation: the proxy occupies a position, the delegate acts, and the guarantor secures completion. Sufficiency names the successful outcome of that replacement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reaches payrolls, civic enrollment, coronation, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Enrollment, Roster, and Payroll
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Workers are entered into a register, assigned service, and maintained by wage or stipend.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enrollment and roster `ك ت ب:B004/m01`; office work `ع م ل:B003/m01`; laboring crew `ع م ل:B006/m01`; wage `ع م ل:B004/m01`; continuing stipend `ج ر ي:B006/m01`; livelihood `ق و م:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The register fixes membership, office assigns function, and recurrent payment sustains the worker. Writing thus operates as a practical technology for coordinating labor and livelihood.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reaches payrolls, civic enrollment, coronation, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covenant and Treaty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties bind themselves by covenant and stabilize the relation through mutual assent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; communal party `ء ه ل:B001/m01`; partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; mutual satisfaction `ر ض و:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A covenant gives durable form to a relation among collective parties. Partnership defines shared interest, and reciprocal satisfaction supplies the condition under which the pact can hold.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reaches payrolls, civic enrollment, coronation, and maritime command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Civic Station, Chief, and Crown
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A settled polity is arranged around a station, a chief, and visible insignia of rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: city and polity `د ي ن:B006/m01`; established station `ق و م:B006/m01`; located place `ك و ن:B002/m01`; chief of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; covering crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; dignity and service `ع ب د:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Place becomes civic station, station receives leadership, and the crown makes rank visible. The maritime chief extends the hierarchy into a mobile polity whose order must be maintained at sea.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel ranges from affiliation by أهل to the visual density of a crowd. Faction and grouped companies show how a collective can be internally organized or split into bounded bodies.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons are located within households, crowds, ranks, or the margins outside them.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Marriage, Affinity, and Caregiving
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Marriage creates an affinity network containing spouses, stepchildren, caregivers, and loving obligation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: marriage and household `ء ه ل:B002/m01`; in-law affinity `ش ر ك:B003/m01`; stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; loving relation `ر ض و:B006/m02`; loving relation `ر ض ي:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Partnership is recast as kinship, and lordly nurture contracts into the intimate work of raising a child from an earlier union. Love gives the resulting household relation an affective rather than merely legal bond.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons are located within households, crowds, ranks, or the margins outside them.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hospitality and Familiar Settlement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inhabited place receives a newcomer and turns unfamiliar presence into welcome and calm.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.

Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini ve görünürlüğün engellenmesi sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zırhın giysiyle veya külün toprakla kaplanması gibi somut bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güneş ışığının yıldızları görünmez kıldığı göksel bağlamda sonuç odaklı doğal karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karanlık geceyi, denizi, büyük ırmağı, gün batımını ve bulutu aynı adlandırma çevresinde toplar; bunların tümünü tek bir gerçek 'kuşatan örtü' türü saymak yerine, karanlık, genişlik veya kapatma etkisiyle örten farklı varlıklar olarak anlamak gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel karanlık ya da genel su kütlesi değildir; kaynakta örtücü etkisiyle adlandırılan belirli varlıklarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, kaynakta doğrudan adlandırılan gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut kapsamıyla tanımlanır; yapıya özgü başka anlam eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Karanlığı, genişliği veya kapatma etkisi nedeniyle kişileri ya da görünümü örten karanlık gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı veya bulut için kullanılan bir nitelemedir.

facets.statement: Karanlık, genişlik ya da kapatma etkisiyle başka şeylerin görünmesini veya seçilmesini engelleyen varlık.
Gece, deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut kaynaklarda bu nitelemenin farklı gönderimleri olarak sıralanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı sözü karanlık gece, deniz ve büyük ırmak için verir; bazı aktarımlar gün batımını ve bulutu da örtücü etkileri nedeniyle bu listeye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Farklı gönderimleri tek bir nesne türüne indirgemeden ortak örtücü etkiyi anlatmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karanlık ve genişlik yoluyla örtme ortaklığını, gönderim çeşitliliğiyle birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün karanlık geceyi nitelediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Deniz, büyük ırmak, gün batımı ve bulut gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı inancın karşıtı ve gerçeğin örtülmesi olarak tanımlar; birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği yadsıma ile inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma türlerini açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dinî gerçeği ve inancı reddetmeyle sınırlıdır; nimeti yadsıma veya yalnızca genel bir gerçeği inkâr etme bunun tamamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskıyla itaatsizliğe sürükleme sürecini açıkça belirtir; geçici çerçeve başlangıç durumu, zorlama ve sonuç ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel zorlama değildir; itaat eden kişinin zorlanarak itaatsizliğe geçirilmesi şarttır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim, itaat eden kişiyi itaatsizliğe zorlama anlamıyla sınırlanır; yalnızca hüküm verme anlamına veya genel baskıya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskı veya zorlamayla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakmaktır.

facets.statement: İtaat eden bir kişiyi zorlayarak itaatsizliğe geçirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı katılımcı değişimini verir: itaat eden kişi dış baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişinin baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya sürüklendiği bağlam için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama işlemini, başlangıçtaki itaati ve itaatsizlik sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İtaatsizliğin açık bir başkaldırı olarak gerçekleştiği anlatı bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Dış baskıyla itaatten karşı koymaya geçişi korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkaldırı düzeyine varmayan itaatsiz davranışları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hedefin önceden itaat etmesini ve zorlamanın onu itaatsizliğe götürmesini şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir kişiyi herhangi bir şeye zorlamayı genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi istemediği bir davranışa baskıyla mecbur bırakma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın başlangıç ve sonuç koşulları belirgindir; komşu dalın zorlama çekirdeğinde itaatten itaatsizliğe geçiş şartı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sonucu doğrudan baskı ve mecbur bırakma yoluyla oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayartma, aldatma veya isteği süsleme yoluyla doğru yoldan saptırmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi önceki doğru veya itaatkâr durumundan uzaklaştırma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirleyici araç zorlamadır; komşu dalda ise yöneltme ve ayartma bulunabilir, mecbur bırakma zorunlu değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel zorlama sınırı ve zorlamasız saptırma ayrımı dalın koşullarını en iyi açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكفرته إذا ألجأت المطيع إلى أن يعصي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الحكم بكفر شخص ولا دعوته كافرا ولا الكفر الديني نفسه
branches.source_phrase_ar: إذا ألجأت مطيعك إلى أن يعصيك فقد أكفرته (ayn;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çiftçinin tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtme işlemini adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar; tekil ve çoğul kişi adları aynı eyleyen rolünü taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekimin bütünü değil, tohumu toprağa koyup üstünü örtme işlemi üzerinden çiftçiyi adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi adları, tohumu toprakla örten çiftçi anlamında tutulur; dinî kişi nitelemesine veya genel ekim sürecine genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Tohumu veya taneyi toprağa yerleştirip üstünü toprakla örten çiftçidir.

facets.statement: Tohumu toprağa yerleştirip üzerini toprakla örten kişi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiftçinin adlandırılmasını tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtmesine bağlar; tekil ve çoğul biçimler aynı eyleyen rolünü gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnızca meslek adıyla değil, tohumu toprakla örtme gerekçesiyle birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Çiftçi rolünü ve tohumu toprakla örtme işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin gerekçesi bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığında doğal kişi adı olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağı işleyip ekim yapan kişi rolünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Tohumu örtme işiyle sınırlandırılmayan bütün çiftçilik faaliyetlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tohumu toprakla örten kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tohumu atma, toprağı ekime hazırlama, ekin ve ekili tarla gibi bütün ekim alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tohumun toprağa verilmesi ve çiftçinin bu süreçteki rolü iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal eyleyen kişiyi örtme gerekçesiyle niteler; komşu dal ise ekim işlemi, ürün ve tarla dâhil daha geniş bir tarım sürecidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çiftçiyi özellikle tohumu toprakla örtmesi bakımından adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çiftçiyi toprağı yarıp işleyen kişi ve çiftçilik mesleğinin taşıyıcısı olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر للزارع والكفار للزراع لأنهم يغطون الحب أو البذر بالتراب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافر المضاد للإيمان ولا الكافر للبحر أو الليل
branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال للزارع كافر لأنه يغطى الحب بتراب الأرض (maqayis)؛ الكافر الزارع لأنه يغطي البذر بالتراب (sihah)؛ الزراع لستره البذر في الأرض (mufradat)؛ الكفار الزراع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnızca bağışlama değildir; günah veya bozulmuş yemin karşısında yükü gideren bir işlem ya da karşılık bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem giderici işlemi hem de günahın etkisinin silinmesi sonucunu kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Günah yükünün bir karşılık veya işlemle ortadan kaldırılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemin bozulduğunda doğan özel yükümlülüğün yerine getirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulan yemin nedeniyle gereken karşılığın yerine getirilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemin dışındaki günah ve kötülüklerin giderilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlemin günahı işlenmemiş gibi kılan sonucunun öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günahın etkisini ve yükünü ortadan kaldırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: günahı veya bozulan yeminin yükünü gideren karşılık
bozulan yeminin gerektirdiği yükümlülüğü yerine getirme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal günah veya yemin yükünü belirli bir karşılık ya da işlemle giderir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hak edilmiş cezayı uygulamamayı ve suçu bağışlayarak silmeyi merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Günahın sonucunu ortadan kaldırma ve onu silinmiş sayma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giderici karşılık veya yükümlülük belirleyicidir; komşu dalda belirleyici olan cezadan vazgeçme ve bağışlamadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçmiş eylemin yükünü gideren karşılığı veya işlemi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin günahtan dönmesini ve davranış yönünü değiştirmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da işlenmiş bir günahla ilişkiyi değiştiren dinî-ahlaki bir süreçtir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak yükün silinmesidir; komşu dalda odak kişinin geri dönüşü ve davranışı bırakmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bağışlama ile günahtan dönme, giderici işlem ile sonuç arasındaki sınırı en iyi açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفارة لما يكفر الخطيئة أو اليمين والتكفير للسيئات والمعاصي حتى تصير كأن لم تعمل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر ضد الإيمان ولا كفران النعمة ولا ستر الأشياء الحسية
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفارة ما يكفر به من الخطيئة واليمين فيمحى به (ayn)؛ تكفير اليمين فعل ما يجب بالحنث فيها والاسم الكفارة والتكفير في المعاصي (sihah)؛ الكفارة ما يغطي الإثم والتكفير ستره وتغطيته حتى يصير بمنزلة ما لم يعمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üzüm salkımının veya hurma çiçeğinin kılıfı
hurma çiçeğinin ya da meyvenin kılıfı
hurma ağacından çıkan kapalı çiçek kılıfları

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tahıl tanesi örtüsü ve ekinin kılıfa girme durumu, nesne ve gelişim aşaması sınırlarını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور والكفرى والكوافير لأكمام العنب أو طلع النخل أو الورقة التي تستر الثمرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافور الطيب ولا عين الماء ولا النبات ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أكمام الثمر ولا الطلع ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور شيء من أخلاط الطيب والكافور عين ماء في الجنة والكافور نبات نوره كنور الأقحوان (ayn)؛ الكافور من الطيب (sihah)؛ الكافور الذي هو من الطيب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlardan uzak araziyi temel gönderim olarak verir; köy, köyler, bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar anlamları ise aynı söz ailesinin ayrı sözlük kullanımlarıdır. Tanım bunları tek bir 'ıssız yer' nesnesi gibi özdeşleştirmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak arazi çekirdeği ile köy, halk ve mezar kullanımları ayrı facetlerdir; dağ geçidi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzak araziye bağlı söz öbeği ile yalın köy, mezar ve çoğul yer-halk kullanımları ayrı tutulur; kapsamları tek anlamda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlardan uzak, pek inilmez ve geçilmez bir araziyi anlatır. Aynı söz ailesinde köy, köyler veya bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar için kaydedilmiş ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: İnsanlardan uzak, pek uğranmayan veya geçilmeyen arazi.
Köy, köyler ve uzak yerlerin halkı aynı söz ailesinin ayrı yer ve topluluk kullanımlarıdır.
Mezar anlamı tek kaynaklı aktarım içinde verilen ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlardan uzak arazi anlamında birleşir; toplu kanıt ayrıca köy, köylerin halkı ve mezar anlamlarını ortak çekirdekten ayrılması gereken sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.

concept_gloss.text: uzak arazi; köy, uzak yer halkı veya mezar
concept_gloss.applicability: Ana uzak arazi anlamını öne alır ve kaynakta aynı dalda tutulan ayrı yer kullanımlarını açıkça işaretler.

error_profile.preserves: Uzak arazi çekirdeğini; köy, uzak yer halkı ve mezar varyantlarından ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz öbeğinin pek uğranmayan uzak araziyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık ve insan uğrağından yoksunluk özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Köy, halk ve mezar kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanlardan uzak araziyi öne çıkarır ve köy ile mezarı ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü sınırlı yeri; mamur, boş, yerleşik veya ıssız oluşuna bakmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Arazi, köy ve mezar gibi yer gönderimleri iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli sözlük gönderimlerine ve uzaklık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği genel yer kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ana yeri insanlardan uzak arazidir; ayrıca köy ve mezar kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yer adı yanında deniz içindeki veya karadan kopuk adayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan yerleşiminden ya da ana karadan ayrılık düşüncesi iki dalı yakınlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklık insanlarla ilişkilidir; komşu dalda fiziksel kopukluk ve ada yapısı belirleyicidir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الثنايا من الجبال ولا البحر ولا الليل ولا الزرع

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ geçitlerini, iri bir dağı ve alçak duvarı aynı söz ailesinde sıralar; geçitleri 'örtülü' saymak kaynakta kurucu bir koşul değildir. Dal bu nedenle örtülülük altında birleştirilmeden coğrafi çekirdek ve ayrı duvar kullanımı olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dağ geçidi ve iri dağ coğrafi facetlerdir; alçak duvar ayrı bir sözlük varyantıdır, köy veya uzak arazi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimleri ayrı tutulur; uzak yer veya genel örtme anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağlar arasındaki geçitler veya iri bir dağ için kullanılan coğrafi bir adlandırmadır; aynı söz ailesinde alçak duvar anlamı da ayrı bir sözlük kullanımı olarak kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Dağlar arasındaki geçit veya geçitler.
İri bir dağ, coğrafi alan içindeki ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.
Alçak duvar, coğrafi çekirdekten ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu dağ geçitlerini verir; toplu kanıt iri dağ ve alçak duvar anlamlarını da aynı söz ailesinin ayrı varyantları olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: dağ geçidi; iri dağ veya alçak duvar
concept_gloss.applicability: Dağ geçidi çekirdeğini öne alırken aynı dalda korunan iki ayrı sözlük varyantını da eksiltmeden gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimlerini birbirinden ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul veya tekil biçimin dağlar arasındaki geçidi gösterdiği coğrafi bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazideki geçit gönderimini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dağ geçidi yanında iri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geçidi özellikle dağ veya vadideki yol kıvrımı ve yürünür güzergâh olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazideki geçit iki dalın ortak gönderimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Geçit gönderiminde yakınlık yüksektir; ancak komşu dal yolun kıvrım ve güzergâh yapısını, bu dal ise ayrı dağ ve duvar varyantlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçidin yalnızca dağlık yer türünü adlandırır ve zorluk koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dik, engebeli ve çıkılması güç bir dağ yolunu veya benzer yükseltileri merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazide geçiş sağlayan yer iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeğinde sarplık veya tırmanış şartı yoktur; komşu dalda güç çıkılan yükselen yol belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ geçidi ile sarp dağ yolu, geçit türünün ve zorluk koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
